items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: Barney Josephson talked to Barney Josephson...put me and Pete Johnson in there... Barney Josephson's band... when it would get slow, Barney Josephson walked up to me... he fired me.

ctx.x: So...John Hammonds talked in...talked to Barney Josephson...put me and Pete Johnson in there. So I was pretty sharp. I was neat...cool. So, we went to work, an' me an' Billie Holiday used to get into a fight all the time.
